description: This file is a shell script that serves as a test framework for Git. It includes setup routines, environment configuration, prerequisite checks, and functions to run and manage tests within the Git project's test suite.

methods.name: prepend_var
methods.description: A utility function to prepend a value to an environment variable with a specified delimiter without overwriting existing content.

methods.name: store_arg_to
methods.description: Variable used internally to store argument handling info during option parsing.

methods.name: parse_option
methods.description: Parses command-line options and sets internal variables accordingly.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Handles cleanup and exits when a fatal error occurs.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Displays an error message and invokes cleanup before exiting.

methods.name: BAIL_OUT
methods.description: Outputs a message and terminates the test script for critical failures.

methods.name: check_test_results_san_file_has_entries_
methods.description: Checks if sanitizer leak report files contain entries indicating leaks.

methods.name: check_test_results_san_file_
methods.description: Processes sanitizer leak report files, logging leaks if found.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks after the test and outputs summary reports.

methods.name: make_symlink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link if it does not already exist or is out of date.

methods.name: make_valgrind_symlink
methods.description: Creates a symlink for a binary to be run under valgrind.

methods.name: remove_trash_directory
methods.description: Removes the specified trash directory, resetting permissions if needed.
